description: This header file declares the PrimaryKeyBuilder class and related functions for managing TPM keys within the cuttlefish namespace, including methods for creating signing and parent keys, as well as functions returning creators for these keys.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder
classes.description: A class providing methods to build TPM primary keys such as signing keys and parent keys, encapsulating key creation parameters.

methods.name: SigningKey
methods.description: Configures the builder to create a signing key.

methods.name: ParentKey
methods.description: Configures the builder to create a parent key.

methods.name: UniqueData
methods.description: Sets unique data to be associated with the key.

methods.name: CreateKey
methods.description: Creates a key in the TPM resource manager based on the builder's configuration.

methods.name: CreateSigningKey
methods.description: Generates a function that creates a TPM signing key with specified unique data.

methods.name: CreateParentKey
methods.description: Generates a function that creates a TPM parent key with specified unique data.
